**Privacy Notice - Pathshala Plus**

Welcome to Pathshala Plus, located in Jaipur, India. We provide a maths and science learning app for students in classes 6 to 10, featuring live doubt-solving classes and weekly tests. You can visit our website at https://pathshalaplus.in. 

Because our users include students under 18, we are committed to protecting your personal information. This notice explains what data we collect, why we use it, and how you can manage your preferences.

**Personal Data We Collect**
When you sign up and give consent, we collect the following information:
* Student's name
* Class and school name
* Parent's mobile number
* Parent's email address
* Test scores and progress reports
* Recordings of live doubt-solving sessions

**Purposes of Data Collection**
We use your personal data strictly for the following purposes:
* To create the student's account and personalise lessons to their class
* To send progress reports and class reminders to the parent
* To record live sessions so the student can rewatch them

**Managing Your Settings and Getting Help**
You can manage your settings at any time in the app or website under **Settings**, and you can get help under **Help**.

**Privacy Contact and Complaints**
If you have any questions, concerns, or complaints regarding your privacy or this notice, please contact our Data Protection Officer:

* **Name:** Ritu Sharma
* **Role:** Data Protection Officer
* **Email:** dpo@pathshalaplus.in

We reply to all complaints within 30 days.
